categories.name: Groceries
categories.description: Food and everyday grocery-store purchases prepared or used at home.

categories.name: Dining
categories.description: Restaurants, takeout, cafes, prepared food bought away from home, and beer, wine, or spirits.

categories.name: Everyday Shopping
categories.description: Routine non-food household and personal purchases, including cleaning and paper goods, toiletries, clothing, footwear, personal care, and ordinary general retail goods that are not projects, gifts, health care, hobbies, or child-specific school and activity costs.

categories.name: Mortgage
categories.description: Mortgage payments and ordinary mortgage charges for the household residence.

categories.name: House Projects & Maintenance
categories.description: Home repairs, maintenance, tools, materials, renovations, and purchases for a named house project.

categories.name: Utilities
categories.description: Electricity, heating, water, internet, phone, and other household utilities.

categories.name: Transportation
categories.description: Transit, taxis, parking, vehicle service, registration, and transportation costs other than fuel.

categories.name: Fuel
categories.description: Gasoline, diesel, charging, and other vehicle energy purchases.

categories.name: Home Insurance
categories.description: Homeowner, tenant, and other insurance premiums covering the household residence.

categories.name: Car Insurance
categories.description: Vehicle insurance premiums and policy charges.

categories.name: Health Care
categories.description: Medical, dental, vision, pharmacy, therapy, and other health-care purchases.

categories.name: Kids & School
categories.description: Childcare, school costs, books, supplies, activities, chore or allowance payments, and child-specific expenses not better classified elsewhere. Child-owned savings deposits are not household savings; custodial deposits of money already owned by a child are not new household spending.

categories.name: Subscriptions
categories.description: Recurring digital services, memberships, software, and media subscriptions.

categories.name: Entertainment & Hobbies
categories.description: Recreation, events, games, hobbies, and non-subscription entertainment.

categories.name: Gifts and Birthdays
categories.description: Birthday presents, holiday gifts, celebrations, and charitable gifts.

categories.name: Trips
categories.description: Lodging, camping, park fees, admission, rentals, and other costs unique to an away trip. Food remains Groceries or Dining, vehicle energy remains Fuel, and durable gear remains Entertainment & Hobbies.

categories.name: Fees and Interest
categories.description: Bank fees, service charges, borrowing interest, and penalties.

categories.name: Property Tax
categories.description: Municipal property-tax assessments and installments for the household residence.

categories.name: Household Income
categories.description: Employment income and other ordinary household income.

categories.name: Borrowed Funds
categories.description: Cash brought on budget by borrowing from an off-budget line of credit or other debt; loan proceeds, not earned household income.

categories.name: Cashback
categories.description: Credit-card cashback paid into the household cashback-staging account.

categories.name: Savings
categories.description: Protected savings allocations and savings transfers.

categories.name: Debt Repayment
categories.description: Principal payments that reduce an off-budget household debt balance.
